items.headline: Potential relief coming as city cleans up collapsed bluff on Muscatine's W Mississippi Drive
items.summary: The city is clearing loose dirt from the collapsed bluff. Once that's done, it will open a single lane for two-way traffic.

items.headline: Davenport couple fulfills lifelong dream of serving in law enforcement together
items.summary: After raising seven children, Nathan and Rebecca Ramker are beginning a new chapter as Scott County reserve deputies.

items.headline: Centennial Bridge project moves forward with recommendation for new location
items.summary: Iowa and Illinois transportation officials recommend building a new Centennial Bridge west of the existing structure. The project still needs federal approval.

items.headline: Moline crossing guard retires after 54 years of keeping generations of students safe
items.summary: For 54 years, Mary Schoeve has stood at the corner of 7th Street and 16th Avenue in Moline, helping generations of children safely make their way to school.

items.headline: MercyOne Air Med celebrates 40 years of lifesaving flights with events across Iowa
items.summary: You're invited to tour the helicopters and meet the lifesaving crews that fly for Air Med during an event in Clinton on Tuesday, Nov. 10.

items.headline: 2,000 eastern Iowa absentee ballots found to not been counted in midterm election, officials say
items.summary: Despite an ensuing audit, election officials do not believe race results will change.

items.headline: Keokuk, Osage among possible measles exposure locations in Iowa
items.summary: According to the latest HHS data, there have been 50 confirmed measles cases in Iowa in 2026. 48 of the patients in those cases had not been vaccinated.
